name: How long does a home restoration project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a home restoration project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a home restoration project depends on its complexity and size. Minor projects might be completed in a few weeks, while extensive whole-house restorations, especially those involving structural changes or multiple trades, can take several months. Factors like material availability, permitting timelines, and unforeseen issues can also influence the schedule. We provide a projected timeline after a detailed project assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies, from weeks for minor updates to several months for extensive restorations, depending on scope and complexity.
